summary_brief: 今日(10-15)延续9月下旬以来\"安全治理+基础设施成熟+编排生产级\"主线，无方向性转折，重心在昨日基础上进一步向\"可观测标准化+企业化落地\"收敛。真正的新推进点有五：其一，OpenTelemetry可观测性由10-14的\"生态落地\"升格为\"统一标准\"——Anthropic四语言SDK、Claude Code、Phoenix、Next.js、Codex同日密集落地拓扑追踪并配官方cookbook与traceparent链路贯穿，是全SDK层面最具体的标准化节点；其二，企业级多代理操作系统实质落地——agno AgentOS同时推出OS Manager团队、Company产品经理域、Projects/Tasks全生命周期与产品CRUD，ruflo新增遥测钩子与记忆导入导出，标志Agent框架从单代理编排跃迁为可运维、可治理的企业级Agent OS；其三，企业合规与数据驻留能力全球化——OpenAI SDK新增日本、印度、澳大利亚存储/处理驻留选项，是当日全新出现的企业主权合规维度；其四，Agent可中断性下探到单次工具调用级——gptme Ctrl+C中断运行中工具、Codex响应期间即时打断、langchain HITL按调用粒度暂停，人机协作控制从模型回合级精化到工具级；其五，终端TUI实时渲染成为CLI代理新竞争焦点——gptme批量流式渲染(13s→0.04s)、opencode响应式diff、ruflo光栅动画。延续层面：沙箱执行隔离与插件信任边界、凭证安全与远程执行鉴权、多模态Agent能力（浏览器/电脑/音频/图片）扩张、上下文压缩与长会话记忆、MCP 2.x/ACP v2协议演进、turbo跨语言托管工具链在同日持续深化。历史定位：生产级成熟阶段延续深化，正由安全的\"堵漏\"与编排的\"可治理\"迈向\"可观测标准化+多语言基建+企业级多代理OS\"，无新的方向性爆发。

engineering_signals.title: OpenTelemetry 成为 AI 应用可观测性的统一标准
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Anthropic 四语言 SDK、Claude Code、Phoenix、Next.js、Codex 等多个项目在同日集中落地 OpenTelemetry 追踪，配合官方 cookbook 教程与 traceparent 链路贯穿，标志着 LLM 应用可观测性从碎片化走向标准化，是全行业的基础设施级升级。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 沙箱执行与安全隔离成为核心演进方向
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 多个项目同步强化 Agent 代码执行的安全边界：agno 的持久化沙箱会话协调器、Vercel harness 的宿主-沙箱分离、dify 的 Landlock fail-closed、Cline 移除插件 in-process 模式、gptme 的 IPython 内核进程隔离，共同指向 Agent 运行时安全隔离成为生产级部署的硬性要求。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 凭证安全与远程执行鉴权全面收紧
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI Codex 远程执行引入命令内凭据掩码与 Bearer 鉴权，Playwright 封堵代理凭据泄漏漏洞，Turborepo 防止缓存投毒写入 Git 元数据，多项目共同强化 Agent 在远程/缓存场景下的凭据隔离与供应链安全，这一安全维度成为当日高影响主题。

engineering_signals.title: 终端 UI 正向实时性与响应式体验演进
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: gptme 的批量流式渲染（13s→0.04s）、opencode 的响应式 diff 布局切换、ruflo 的光栅动画渲染、OpenHands 的阅读节奏流式输出，多个终端 Agent 工具同步优化 TUI 渲染性能与交互实时性，反映 CLI 代理体验质量成为竞争焦点。

engineering_signals.title: 多模态 Agent 能力密集落地（浏览器、电脑、音频、图片）
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI SDK 引入 BrowserToolset 与 ComputerToolset、Vercel AI 为 Google 增加 AUDIO 模态、agno 沙箱代理支持图片文件、opencode 支持 URL 图像输入，多项目同期扩展 Agent 的多模态感知与物理世界执行能力，指向 Agent 从文本对话向全模态操作代理演进。

engineering_signals.title: 上下文压缩与长会话记忆管理成为跨项目攻坚点
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: gptme 的双重压缩机制、Claude Code 的闲置自动压缩、Cod ex 的压缩失败保护与压缩分块、CrewAI 的主动压缩、ruflo 的 TieredMemoryStore 自然语言召回，多个项目同期集中解决长上下文溢出与记忆连续性难题，反映 Agent 长期自主运行的可靠性需求高涨。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 协议生态快速演进：MCP 2.x 与 ACP v2 双轨并进
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Microsoft agent-framework 与 agentscope 同步适配 MCP 2.x SDK，Zed 推进 Agent Client Protocol v2 的会话与配置体系，Vercel AI 发布 MCP 事件订阅 breaking 变更，整个 Agent 互联协议层正在密集迭代，预示下一代 Agent 通信标准的成型。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 从单实例向企业级多代理操作系统演进
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: agno 的 AgentOS 同期推出 OS Manager 团队、Company 域（产品经理代理）、Projects/Tasks 全生命周期与产品 CRUD，ruflo 推出遥测钩子与记忆导入导出，标志 Agent 框架从单代理编排升级为可运维、可治理的 Agent 操作系统，是企业级落地的重要标志。

engineering_signals.title: 安全审查与插件信任边界显式化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Claude 官方插件的 commit 审查器收窄为只读工具、状态文件原子写入防截断、Cline 强制插件 worker 隔离、opencode 插件权限断言能力、ruflo 静态分析检测注入 exec，多个项目同期将插件与审查工具的权限边界显式化，是 AI 编程助手生态安全治理的系统性加固。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 可中断性与人机协作实时控制能力增强
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: gptme 支持 Ctrl+C 中断运行中工具、Codex 支持响应期间即时打断、langchain HITL 中间件按调用粒度暂停、opencode 增加 Promise 钩子错误隔离，多个项目将人工中断与实时干预从模型回合级细化到单次工具调用级，是交互式 Agent 可控性演进的关键方向。

engineering_signals.title: 跨运行时工具链现代化（Bun、uv、pnpm）
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Playwright 测试运行器支持 Bun 并纳入 CI、gptme 从 Poetry 迁移到 uv、Next.js 升级 pnpm v10→v12，多个大型项目同步推进包管理器与运行时现代化，反映 JS/Python 生态工具链向更快、更统一的构建体系迁移。

engineering_signals.title: 可复现开发环境与托管工具链落地（turbo setup）
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Turborepo 同期在原生 Windows x64 上托管 Node、pnpm、Rust、Bun、Python 等完整的锁定工具链，并新增离线/镜像安装与 OIDC 鉴权，是可复现跨平台开发环境的重大基础设施落地，配合安全加固代表了构建工具链向供应链安全的演进。

engineering_signals.title: 企业合规与数据驻留能力的全球化拓展
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI SDK 新增日本、印度、澳大利亚的存储与处理驻留选项，配合 agno 的企业级 company 域、langgraph 私有镜像部署密钥支持，共同反映 AI 平台面向企业客户的主权合规能力建设成为刚需。

engineering_signals.title: SDK 连接基础设施性能大幅优化（连接复用与缓存）
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI SDK 恢复异步流式连接复用、gptme 复用 HTTP 会话避免重建连接池、TLS 根证书加载去重、deer-flow MCP 工具发现缓存，多个 SDK 与框架集中优化底层连接与缓存复用，直接降低高频调用成本与延迟。

release_signals.title: Claude Code 高频迭代与可观测性增强
release_signals.why_it_matters: Claude Code 在三天内连续发布三个版本，新增 OpenTelemetry 语义化追踪、闲置自动压缩、vim 模式增强等关键能力，并修复大量稳定性问题，是 AI 编程助手领域的重大演进。

release_signals.title: Anthropic SDK 原生支持 OpenTelemetry
release_signals.why_it_matters: Python、TypeScript、Go、Java 等主流 Anthropic SDK 同步加入原生 OpenTelemetry 追踪支持，为 LLM 应用的可观测性建立了统一标准，极大简化了追踪集成成本。

release_signals.title: OpenAI Codex 支持即时打断与并行工具
release_signals.why_it_matters: Codex 新增响应期间即时发送后续指令、并行执行只读工具、可搜索的 /config 面板等特性，显著提升了 AI 编程代理的交互效率和可控性。

release_signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK 强化恢复与沙箱安全
release_signals.why_it_matters: v0.24.0 引入运行级工具异常格式化、改进的会话恢复机制和更严格的沙箱安全策略（如 macOS 禁止 Launch Services），提升了代理的健壮性和安全性。

release_signals.title: Microsoft Agent Framework 统一内容语义
release_signals.why_it_matters: Python 1.22.0 跨所有 Provider 整合内容身份、托管执行和流合并语义，是框架层面的重大架构统一，并新增 Python 3.15 支持，但引入持久化状态不兼容警告。

release_signals.title: gptme 大版本更新聚焦上下文压缩
release_signals.why_it_matters: v0.35.0 包含 61 项新特性和 217 项修复，重点推进了分阶段上下文压缩（compaction）机制，并新增内存监控、TUI 改进和多种新模型支持，是项目的重要里程碑。

release_signals.title: Next.js 发布关键安全修复
release_signals.why_it_matters: v16.4.1 和 v15.5.28 修复了包括未认证远程代码执行在内的多个严重安全漏洞，影响所有使用 `use cache` 和 Image Optimization API 的 Next.js 应用，必须立即升级。

release_signals.title: Zed 编辑器增强 AI 与 Git 工作流
release_signals.why_it_matters: v1.24.2 新增 Git 标签创建、终端标签拖入 Agent 面板、文件查找器预填充等特性，并优化了 AI 响应时的内存和 CPU 使用，提升了开发者日常效率。

release_signals.title: AutoGPT 平台商业化与体验优化
release_signals.why_it_matters: v0.8.4 主要围绕 Copilot 聊天体验、钱包/计费系统、专家市场等商业化功能进行迭代，并支持 Gemini 4 Argon 等新模型，标志着平台从技术验证向产品化转型。

release_signals.title: LangChain 与 LangGraph 稳步迭代
release_signals.why_it_matters: LangChain 核心库新增 HITL 中间件按调用中断功能，LangGraph 的 Postgres 检查点支持数据清理，持续巩固其作为 LLM 应用开发框架的生态地位。

release_signals.title: OpenClaw 发布 LTS 版本强化稳定性
release_signals.why_it_matters: 作为 gateway-only 的 extended-stable 版本，它聚合了 9 月底以来的关键安全更新和可靠性修复，并新增 Meta Muse Wonder 等模型支持，为生产环境用户提供了稳定选择。

release_signals.title: Phoenix 可观测性平台支持新模型
release_signals.why_it_matters: v20.22.0 在 Playground 中新增对 Meta Muse Wonder 和 Gemini 4 Argon 的支持，并补充了 Claude Managed Agents 的追踪文档，持续扩展其 LLM 可观测性生态。

release_signals.title: DeepAgents 增强异步子代理追踪
release_signals.why_it_matters: v0.7.26 让异步子代理的追踪嵌套在父代理下，并能报告等待人工输入的状态，提升了多代理系统的可观测性和调试体验。

release_signals.title: CrewAI 引入评估命令与上下文窗口优化
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增 `crewai eval` 命令用于定位模型中断原因，并改用 LiteLLM 目录管理上下文窗口，提升了框架的可调试性和模型兼容性。

release_signals.title: OpenAI Python SDK 新增浏览器与计算机工具
release_signals.why_it_matters: v3.31.0 开始分阶段引入浏览器和计算机工具集，这标志着 OpenAI SDK 从纯模型调用向更广泛的代理能力（如网页操作）扩展。

release_signals.title: Fabric 修复 Bedrock 推理内容块处理
release_signals.why_it_matters: 修复了在 Bedrock 上处理推理内容块的问题，确保使用 Bedrock 作为后端的用户能获得更稳定的输出，提升了跨云平台的兼容性。

release_signals.title: Ruflo TUI 支持图形化显示
release_signals.why_it_matters: v3.56.10 为 `ruflo tui` 命令新增了绘制控制台图片、外观和动画的能力，并修复了 MCP 服务器和守护进程的多个问题，提升了终端用户体验。

release_signals.title: OpenCode 停止会话共享功能
release_signals.why_it_matters: v1.19.1 宣布停止会话共享功能，这是一个重要的产品决策，可能影响依赖该功能进行协作的用户，需要关注其替代方案。

release_signals.title: vercel/ai 批量发版 338 个子包（8 个值得注意）
release_signals.why_it_matters: vercel/ai 这批发版共 338 个子包，绝大部分是依赖同步的例行 patch 升级，本身无实质变更。但其中夹杂了若干值得关注的能力与修复：@ai-sdk/mcp 含一处实验性 BREAKING（事件订阅改用 ttlMs），ai 核心新增可配置的工具执行并发，Google 新增 AUDIO 模态、openai-compatible 新增 URL 图像、typesafe-ai 新增图片输入，harness 系列增强工具审批与模型输出转换。整体为 patch 级能力聚合升级，含新能力与一处实验性 breaking，综合影响中等。

release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增可配置的工具调用执行并发能力，影响核心运行时

release_signals.why_it_matters: 为 Google 语言模型新增 AUDIO 响应模态支持

release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增基于 URL 的图像响应支持

release_signals.why_it_matters: 重写适配器以使用 libfx，实现宿主-沙箱分离并解锁新能力

release_signals.why_it_matters: 支持最新 FLUX 图像 API 的默认转发并扩大安全容差范围

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS` so unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) ends a request at a usage limit that resets too far away instead of waiting
- Added OpenTelemetry tracing guidance to the `claude-api` skill, including setting up trace destinations with the `ant` CLI
- Added the `%` motion to vim mode: jump to the matching bracket, alone or with d/c/y
- Added `rows` to a mod's `Input`: a text field of several lines in the terminal, where Enter submits and Shift+Enter or a backslash before Enter starts a new line
- Added `classifier_verdict` and `permission_mode` to OpenTelemetry `tool_decision` events, so auto mode classifier decisions can be told apart from permission rules
- Added `classifier_category` to OpenTelemetry `tool_decision` events, naming the built-in rule a classifier block matched, when `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1`
- Fixed quitting removing a worktree made by a `WorktreeCreate` hook without asking when it may hold unpushed commits
- Fixed the `fable` (and `best`) model alias erroring on the Anthropic API when the newest Fable model is not available to your organization: Claude Code now retries once on the previous Fable model
- Fixed a misleading "Please run /login" error when a full disk keeps the login from being refreshed; the error now names the disk and says to delete files
- Fixed Grep and Glob reporting no matches when the search program failed unexpectedly before returning any results; they now return an error saying the search failed
- Fixed workflow agents sometimes skipping their step, and the run still reporting success, after reading the harness note that their task text carries no user authority
- Fixed artifact updates being refused where a PreToolUse hook covers Edit or Write; Claude now edits the file and then republishes instead of changing it in the publish call
- Fixed skills and commands with very many or very long argument names stalling for seconds when invoked; only the first 64 names, each up to 64 characters, are now filled in
- Fixed skills, commands and hooks using very large amounts of memory when their arguments fill many placeholders
- Fixed stray characters such as `>0q` covering the folder trust prompt, and `>4m` before the shell prompt at exit, in terminals built on VTE older than 0.53 such as MATE Terminal on RHEL 8
- Fixed stray `GOK` text appearing in the prompt at startup in some versions of iTerm2
- Fixed switching to a model whose name contains `application-inference-profile` running your `awsAuthRefresh` command and delaying model-switch hooks when the provider is not Bedrock
- Fixed sign-in refresh timeouts and unexpected sign-outs after a short command such as `claude auth status` or `claude plugin list` exited in the middle of a token refresh
- Fixed a tool call cut off by a message sent mid-turn during its permission check being reported to the model as rejected by the user
- Fixed a case where switching to a model with a smaller context window could spend usage credits on a summary by the previous model without asking first
- Fixed conversations being compacted over and over, on a model you didn't pick, behind an LLM gateway whose responses name a different model than the one requested
- Fixed vim mode sometimes staying in INSERT after Escape on a slow or busy machine
- Fixed Esc discarding a typed AskUserQuestion answer in vim mode: the free-text field now supports vim NORMAL mode, and Esc cancels only from NORMAL
- Fixed the Read tool reading binary files such as .xlsm, .parquet, .epub and .heic as text
- Fixed a Markdown table with only a header row drawing nothing when too wide for the terminal, including in plans on the plan approval card
- Fixed the /claude-api skill saying CMEK external-key endpoints aren't available on Claude Platform on AWS
- Fixed skills no longer being listed to the model after using `/rewind`
- Fixed the compaction row in a resumed session offering ctrl+o for history that is not loaded; it now says where the earlier messages are saved, and also shows in fullscreen
- Fixed the "new task? /clear to save tokens" hint coming back right after you interrupt a response
- Fixed the permission prompt for a plugin or skill hook's `ask` decision not showing which plugin or skill the hook comes from
- Fixed `/diff` not noticing a conflicted cherry-pick or revert in reftable repositories when one of its git checks timed out or failed
- Fixed workflow scripts asking for permission or being refused when read, edited or re-run after a Bash `cd` in the same session
- Fixed dim text on the dark ANSI theme and 16-color terminals: faint inside filled boxes, not faint under selection and search highlights, and list descriptions dimmed like other secondary text
- Fixed a mod's `$.model.fork` returning `nothing-to-fork` when called before the first response of a new Claude Code process had finished, as in `claude -p` runs and cloud sessions
- Fullscreen mode: Fixed `/compact` and auto-compact briefly freezing the UI while the visible transcript is rebuilt
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions started from Slack being unable to find or attach a repository when managed settings restrict MCP servers; use `deniedMcpServers` to keep those tools off
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions being reported as having a deleted source branch, and not retried, when an unrelated setup or session failure quoted git's missing-ref wording
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed the log promising a retry of a failed or declined session release for a session that is ending; repeated failures now show a count
- Windows: Fixed stopped background PowerShell commands missing the closing `[killed]` line in their output file
- Improved switching to a model with a smaller context window: a conversation too long for the new model is now summarized by the previous model first
- Improved rendering performance while a long-running subagent works: its progress trail now updates incrementally instead of being reprocessed in full on every render
- Improved artifacts: pages Claude writes now paint the band above a sticky header, so scrolled text no longer shows there in the mobile apps
- Improved mods: in VS Code and the desktop and mobile apps, a tree drawn above the question dialog can now hold Markdown and up to 48 rows; the terminal keeps 12 plain rows
- Changed a mod hook's `.catch` handler to run only when the hook throws or times out; events raised beneath the hook's own calls now skip that hook without asking its `.catch`
- Changed a mod's `$.env.set` to resolve with `{}` once the variable is set or unset, or with `{ deny }` saying why when the write is not made
- [VSCode] Added LaTeX math rendering in Claude's responses, including `$$` and multi-line `\[ … \]` blocks and inline `$…$` and `\(…\)` math
- [VSCode] Added a "Get more usage" link to the usage-limit banner for Pro and Max plans in the VS Code and JetBrains panels

## What's changed

- Added per-tool permission policies to sdk-type MCP server configs: `tools` entries with `permission_policy` `always_ask` or `always_deny`, applied on `initialize` and `setMcpServers()`
- Added `BUILTIN_TOOL_NAMES` and `LEGACY_TOOL_NAME_ALIASES` exports: the public built-in tool names and their earlier names, for checking permission rules and tool settings
- Added `addPlugins` to `Query.reloadPlugins()` so a host can load more plugin folders into a running session
- Fixed `setModel()` with a model ID failing while the account is at its five-hour or weekly usage limit; the model now applies and the next message reports the limit
- Changed the error when a full disk keeps the login from being refreshed: `error` is now `invalid_request`, not `authentication_failed`, and `api_error_status` is `null`, not 401
- Changed `mcpServerStatus()` to still report a tool's `_meta.ui.visibility` when the rest of its `_meta.ui` fails validation
- Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.301

## Update

```sh
npm install @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.301
# or
yarn add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.301
# or
pnpm add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.301
# or
bun add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.301
```

## Changes

### PR [#2141](https://github.com/danielmiessler/Fabric/pull/2141) by [putramkti](https://github.com/putramkti) and [ksylvan](https://github.com/ksylvan): fix: handle carriage return input in interactive setup prompts

- Fixed interactive setup hanging when terminals (such as kitty on macOS) send a bare carriage return instead of a newline; prompts now accept Enter reliably.
- Added a `readLine` helper that terminates on either `\r` or `\n`, strips the `\n` from `\r\n` pairs, and shares a single `bufio.Reader` so buffered input is not lost between questions.
- Simplified plugin input handling by removing redundant newline trimming from setup question answers.
- Removed mutex locking from the shared standard input reader initialization.
- Consolidated line-ending tests into table-driven LF, CRLF, and CR cases, replacing the standalone carriage-return and scripted setup question tests.

key_changes: 修复了交互式设置提示在部分终端（如 macOS 上的 kitty）发送裸回车符而非换行符时挂起的问题

优化了插件输入处理，移除了冗余的换行符裁剪逻辑
移除了共享标准输入读取器初始化时的互斥锁
将行结尾测试整合为表驱动的 LF、CRLF 和 CR 测试用例
ai_summary.summary_cn: 此版本修复了交互式设置提示在遇到裸回车符（\\r）输入时挂起的缺陷，该问题主要影响发送回车而非换行的终端环境（如 macOS 上的 kitty）。通过引入统一的 readLine 辅助函数，提示现在能够可靠地处理 LF、CRLF 和 CR 等多种行结尾格式，并优化了底层输入读取器的实现。变更还包含测试用例的整合与简化，提升了后续维护的可读性。

- Fixes YouTube visual OCR cues so timestamps come from real ffmpeg frame timing instead of the OCR result index.
- Parses `pts_time` from ffmpeg `showinfo` output and formats cue ranges from actual frame times, with a safe fallback.

key_changes: 全新压缩（compaction）系统：引入阶段化上下文管理，支持较长历史摘要、自动上下文预算警告与溢出恢复
安全功能强化：新增 URL 主机名自动访问白名单、行为异常看门狗（作用域逃逸/写入风暴/新主机检测）、shell 低内存卫士自动终止最大命令
模型与提供方支持更新：注册 Mistral Large 4、GPT-6 Sol/Luna，支持 subscription 提供方（ChatGPT/Grok/OpenRouter PKCE）设置
TUI 大幅改进：支持排队提示词、运行中工具调用及超时显示、命令行接受提示、状态行、/restart 切换界面、--resume 列表选择
WebUI/服务端增强：全局 MCP 设置、提供方健康状态指示、SSE token 传递、LAN 访问二维码（Tauri 应用）
ai_summary.summary_cn: gptme v0.35.0 是一次功能密集型大版本更新，核心围绕全新的分阶段 compaction 系统展开，引入了更智能的上下文管理，包括长窗口历史摘要、容量上限设置和自动溢出恢复。同时大幅强化了安全能力（URL 白名单、行为异常检测、shell 内存卫士）和 TUI/WebUI 用户体验（排队提示、状态行、运行中工具显示等）。此外，还新增了对 Mistral Large 4 和 GPT-6 系列等新模型的支持，并提供了更完善的远程访问与 MCP 配置能力。

releases.summary:
## New Features

- Open `/config` to search preferences across categories, change supported settings immediately, and see which changes require a restart. (#52990, #53429)
- Send a follow-up while Codex is responding to steer it immediately. Interrupting a turn also stops active Code Mode cells and their nested tool calls. (#51812, #51835)
- Configure a leader key in `/keymap`. The default is `Ctrl+X`, shortcut hints stay open until you choose or cancel, and voice mute moves to `F9`. (#52273)
- Restart a managed background server from `/daemon`. Codex warns about work the restart could interrupt, then reconnects automatically. (#53173)
- Codex can run independent read-only tools in parallel, including skill, memory, and conversation-history lookups. (#52245)
- Daybreak is enabled by default for eligible accounts. `codex exec` can also select it with an OpenAI API key when the server offers access. (#53701, #53717)

## Bug Fixes

- Resuming a saved thread restores its permissions and network approvals, while respecting explicit overrides and current managed policy. (#53150, #53419, #53424)
- The network proxy now checks permission before a DNS lookup, rejects duplicate `Host` headers, and prevents credential aliases from bypassing inspection hooks. (#51650, #52661, #53506)
- Return to an existing side conversation with `/side` after switching threads. Answers to pending prompts also go back to the thread that asked. (#52184, #53436)
- On Windows, `Ctrl+V` and `Shift+Insert` paste text as well as images. On WSL, repeated pastes reuse the clipboard reader, and copy attempts time out instead of hanging. (#53224, #52967, #53453)
- Local commands finish promptly when a child keeps an output pipe open. Remote commands preserve late-arriving output so the final poll can still collect it. (#52652, #53331, #53622)
- `codex exec` no longer prints the same file diff again after an unrelated command. (#53444)

## Documentation

- Updated the bundled OpenAI Docs guidance for migrations to the GPT-6 family, including model-specific reasoning, tool use, and data residency considerations. (#51768)
- Clarified how the Linux sandbox uses bubblewrap for filesystem isolation and seccomp for syscall filtering. (#52610)

## Chores

- Codex now uses its standard shell executor and no longer bundles a patched `zsh`. Configurations using the retired shell flags receive a migration notice. (#52160, #52213)
- Reduced Linux and macOS release package size by stripping symbols from packaged binaries while preserving them in the original build outputs. (#52178)

ai_summary.summary_cn: 本版本重点增强了 TUI 用户体验与后台管理能力，新增可搜索的 /config 设置面板、可配置引导键、后台服务器重启功能，并默认启用 Daybreak 与即时打断响应机制。同时修复了线程恢复权限、网络代理安全校验、剪贴板粘贴及输出管道等多处缺陷，并移除了补丁版 zsh 以简化执行后端、减小发布包体积。

摘要中间件现在对外暴露了其 summarizer 组件，便于用户自定义摘要逻辑

ai_summary.summary_cn: deepagents 0.7.26 版本主要增强了异步子代理的可观测性，包括在等待人工时进行状态上报、将子代理运行嵌套到父代理追踪中并标识发起代理，以及将摘要中间件的 summarizer 组件对外暴露。同时修复了工具结果路径在解析后未保留的问题，并提升了一些依赖项的最低版本要求。

releases.summary:
This is a gateway-only `extended-stable` release, which is our current equivalent to LTS. This release is OpenClaw from the end of September 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. The latest version of OpenClaw at the time of this release is [2026.10.3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases#release-v2026.10.3)

## 2026.9.33

### Highlights

- **Safer September upgrades:** updates on the 2026.9 line keep state, plugin data, service ownership, and Windows state paths intact, and refuse automatic restore over unattributed Doctor writes. (#160167, #166755) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vyctorbrzezowski, @jalehman, @Alix-007, @jayzhou2309, @nitinjwadhawan, @SunnyShu0925, @obviyus, @vincentkoc, @taihartman, and @DonnieFi.
- **Updates that finish on pnpm, npm, and Windows:** pnpm 12 Gateway services and launchers survive native updates, retained updater runtimes no longer block npm recovery, and Windows updates no longer roll back after Doctor rechecks driver ancestry. (#170003, #170131, #170170, #169563) Thanks @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **New model support:** run Meta Muse Wonder, use MiniMax M3.1 thinking effort levels, and stay signed in to MiniMax portal OAuth past token expiry. (#170232, #160089, #160459) Thanks @RomneyDa, @NianJiuZst, @Takhoffman, @php737, @masatohoshino, @rongtianhua, @DonnieFi, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **More reliable model turns:** agent runs honor live thinking levels, local providers get response-header deadlines, ChatGPT WebSocket normal closes recover, and Codex replies keep their final tokens. (#168566, #168282, #167512, #168400) Thanks @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @mightyx, @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @masatohoshino, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, and @ajmtrz.
- **Work survives Gateway restarts:** interrupted automation turns, steered sessions, cloud worker claims, and partial worker replies now resume or persist after a restart. (#170162, #170252, #170161, #170223) Thanks @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **Delivery and device stability:** live sends survive queue recovery, and node requests no longer fail on unrelated pairing activity or while another device's pairing is written. (#169010, #169486, #169575) Thanks @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **Agent and update stability:** carry a broad batch of compatible October fixes for agent turns, sessions, channels, and update recovery. (#170476) Thanks @RomneyDa, @yetval, @Dimitri-lcht, @Program-123, @dhruv1220, @Shenrui-Ma, @igs-rogenlo, @changeroa, @hxy91819, @Takhoffman, @harjothkhara, @TYY-2005, @giodl73-repo, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @jalehman, @wangmiao0668000666, and @an2in.

### Changes

- **Meta:** add the Muse Wonder model to the catalog and onboarding with max thinking support, keeping Spark as the default. (#170232) Thanks @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **MiniMax:** add the MiniMax M3.1 Flash Preview model and route its thinking effort levels to the provider. (#160089) Thanks @NianJiuZst, @Takhoffman, @php737, @DonnieFi, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **LM Studio:** refreshing saved inventory now discovers newly loaded models. (#168039) Thanks @jb-lopez, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.

### Fixes

- **Update and Doctor:** keep Doctor running under unreadable supervisors and child binding errors, keep clean service install refusals out of native-authority recovery, stop update history writes from stalling cron and cleanup, avoid bookkeeping-only repair refusals, and never delete an OAuth profile because the legacy auth store is unreadable. (#169665, #169658, #169283, #170195, #170256) Thanks @DonnieFi, @Yolo521-bot, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **Updating from 2026.8.35:** cron jobs approved with "allow always" keep running unattended after the update, pnpm 12 Gateway services left on a deleted store generation are rewritten to the durable install link, Doctor defers optional checks so updates finish under older updaters' time limits, official plugins with removed SDK imports are no longer silently kept, and Kubernetes pods run Doctor before starting. (#171816) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Gateway responsiveness:** long streamed replies that start with a reply tag such as `[[reply_to_current]]` no longer re-parse the whole reply on every delta, which could keep the Gateway busy for tens of seconds. #166781 (#166782) Thanks @boeingchoco and @obviyus.
- **Tailscale:** an interrupted Tailscale Serve start stops its serve process, the Gateway keeps local access when the tailnet denies Serve, and public chat no longer returns 503s right after startup. #167436 (#167514, #171509, #167604) Thanks @pandysp and @RomneyDa.
- **Context engine:** sessions holding an old blocked turn no longer repeat the blocked-turn warning and re-read it on every run. (#167595) Thanks @jalehman.
- **State database:** state reads no longer stay closed until a Gateway restart after a failed state cleanup. Fixes #162085. (#171709) Thanks @RomneyDa and @residentb2b.
- **Update summaries and Doctor:** successful updates stop listing settled plugin data and settings upgrades as pending, optional dreaming-cron inspection or snapshot cleanup failures no longer block updates, and macOS LaunchAgent repair accepts an in-progress bootstrap. (#170413, #170754, #170740) Thanks @RomneyDa and @DonnieFi.
- **Providers:** recover DeepSeek `calls` markup instead of leaking tool payloads, recover Codex follow-up requests after failed thread preparation, and select aliased llama.cpp models while failing setup when credentials cannot be saved. (#169728, #169431, #168232) Thanks @TOMUIV, @jjjhenriksen, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **Channels and tools:** channel tools keep working after a config write restarts the account, ACP agents keep plugin and OpenClaw tools when acpx is installed separately, Talk consultations no longer abort right after connecting, and routed turns deliver blocking questions. (#164848, #159396, #164272, #170083, #170039) Thanks @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @ajmtrz, @brokemac79, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, and @mightyx.
- **Automation:** failed one-shot automations always alert, and cron no longer holds the state writer while waiting on host admission. (#169102, #168291) Thanks @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **Release checks:** Windows installer checks tolerate slow `gateway stop` help and surface cleanup errors, packaged checks recover from a busy Gateway port, and extended-stable candidates now qualify upgrades from the previous extended-stable release. (#169567, #170178, #171565) Thanks @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.9.9..a902bd2d4bd1707cdc0c861bb9bf92727645f700 history: 65 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 65 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

key_changes: 新增 Meta Muse Wonder 和 MiniMax M3.1 Flash Preview 模型支持，并优化 MiniMax OAuth 登录持久性
大幅提升更新流程稳定性：保护 2026.9 系列升级时的状态数据、插件数据及服务所有权，支持 pnpm/npm/Windows 平台无缝更新，修复 Windows 更新回滚问题
增强 Gateway 重启后的恢复能力：中断的自动化任务、会话、云端 worker 认领及部分回复均可在重启后继续或持久化
修复多个模型交互可靠性问题：Agent 运行遵循实时思考级别、本地 provider 响应延迟处理、ChatGPT WebSocket 正常关闭恢复、Codex 回复保留最终 token
修复 Tailscale、状态数据库、上下文引擎、DeepSeek/Codex/llama.cpp 等多个 provider 及渠道的稳定性问题
ai_summary.summary_cn: v2026.9.33 是一个 gateway 专有的 extended-stable（LTS 级别）版本，主要聚焦于安全更新和稳定性提升。该版本引入了 Meta Muse Wonder 和 MiniMax M3.1 新模型支持，大幅增强了更新流程在 pnpm、npm 和 Windows 平台上的可靠性与数据保护，同时优化了 Gateway 重启后的任务恢复能力和多个模型 provider 的交互稳定性。

### Release readiness review (v0.23.1 -> TARGET 0f44a46474d1f37a6b0ee006251a78bde4179bea)

This is a release readiness report done by `$final-release-review` skill.

### Diff

https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python/compare/v0.23.1...0f44a46474d1f37a6b0ee006251a78bde4179bea

### Release intent

- Review mode: final candidate, Release Please PR #5285.
- Intended release: minor, 0.24.0.
- Minimum required release type: minor. Existing tool error formatters receive a new category, and the RunState reader restricts some legacy agent identities.
- Versioning verdict: compatible with the required minor release.

### Release call

**🟢 GREEN LIGHT TO SHIP.** The prepared 0.24.0 candidate has no unresolved release blocker. Its compatibility changes have supported migration or fallback paths described below.

### Scope summary

- 111 files changed (+15,444/-1,412). Main areas: tool execution and failure recovery, durable RunState and session history, sandbox safety, tracing, examples, dependencies, and release metadata.
- The candidate contains current main and #5335. Changes beyond main are limited to release-owned metadata.

### Risk assessment (ordered by impact)

1. **Route affected saved runs to their original SDK and agent code.**
   - Risk: **🟢 LOW**, with a required upgrade precaution. Some previously readable checkpoints now fail safely instead of risking incorrect agent ownership.
   - Evidence: the writer advances from schema 1.18 to 1.21. The reader rejects certain older graphs with same-name non-root agents whose saved identity ordering could have depended on hook attributes, even when those attributes remained unchanged. New identity generation excludes all hook instance attributes and retains the hook type. Graphs distinguishable only by those attributes cannot be serialized. Other supported historical schemas remain readable.
   - Files: `src/agents/run_state.py`, `src/agents/_run_state_agent_identity.py`, `tests/test_run_state.py`.
   - Action: finish affected legacy tasks with the original SDK, unchanged agent definitions, and hook ordering used when the snapshot was written. Use unique agent names before starting new durable runs. Do not rename a stored graph or change its schema label to force migration. Older SDKs cannot read new 1.21 snapshots.

2. **Update existing custom tool error formatters for a third category.**
   - Risk: **🟢 LOW**, with an explicit migration for exhaustive callbacks. A formatter that treats every non-rejection as a missing tool can now return misleading text for a crashed function.
   - Evidence: `ToolErrorFormatterArgs.kind` adds `"tool_exception"`; the optional `error` field is appended. The run-wide callback now handles eligible decorated function failures. Explicit per-tool handlers, including explicit `None` or the default handler, keep precedence. Factory-created MCP and `Agent.as_tool` failures, timeouts, cancellation, and schema-backed program calls keep their separate behavior.
   - Files: `src/agents/run_config.py`, `src/agents/tool.py`, `src/agents/run_internal/tool_execution.py`, `tests/test_tool_exception_formatter.py`.
   - Action: handle `"tool_exception"` explicitly or return `None` for it to retain the default message. Keep exception details out of model-visible output unless deliberately sanitized. With no custom formatter, default behavior stays unchanged.

3. **Preserve completed work without promising automatic replay.**
   - Risk: **🟢 LOW**. Recovery retains more completed work, but applications must still reconcile external side effects and partially committed history.
   - Evidence: deferred approval history waits for the output guardrail boundary. For client-managed runs, accepted call/output pairs survive sibling or callback failures after input and tool-output guardrails permit publication. Server-managed conversations retain their separate recovery path. Pending writes retain session identity and compaction state. Automatic compaction waits for pending approvals; standalone Redis replacement uses a transaction. Conversations writes use batches of at most 20 items and can commit partially across requests.
   - Files: `src/agents/run_internal/session_persistence.py`, `src/agents/run_internal/tool_execution.py`, `src/agents/memory/openai_conversations_session.py`, `src/agents/memory/openai_responses_compaction_session.py`, `src/agents/extensions/memory/redis_session.py`.
   - Action: resume supported nonterminal failures with the original session backend and ID, using returned state and history instead of replaying completed tools. After a partial Conversations append, inspect and repair remote history before retrying; do not resend the full list while an earlier part remains stored. Coordinate other writers; Redis atomic replacement does not prevent stale compaction across processes. Redis Cluster reads and pops remain available, but transactional append, clear, and replacement require a supported backend. Terminal output failures do not become replayable.

4. **Retain the intended sandbox, tracing, and display boundaries.**
   - Risk: **🟢 LOW**. macOS local commands can no longer launch host applications through Launch Services; disabled runs emit fewer spans inside caller-owned traces.
   - Evidence: #5335 adds Launch Services denial to the shared normal/PTY macOS profile. Native coverage checks the operating-system decision. Sandbox input validation returns recoverable tool errors without swallowing provider failures. Protected mount failures produce fresh redacted errors. Source arguments and linked exceptions remain intact, but the caught source traceback is detached. Tracing opt-out covers resumed tools and streamed cleanup, while resumed approved tools use the agent span. The realtime example renders tool content as literal text.
   - Files: `src/agents/sandbox/sandboxes/unix_local.py`, `src/agents/sandbox/_mount_security.py`, `src/agents/run.py`, `src/agents/tracing/`, `examples/realtime/app/static/app.js`.
   - Action: retain the macOS behavior note and #5335 reporter credit in the release. Do not describe local sandboxing as complete host or network isolation; use the documented Docker or hosted alternatives where needed. No tracing or realtime configuration migration is required.

5. **Keep additive integrations and dependency requirements explicit.**
   - Risk: **🟢 LOW**. Consumers opting into metadata, examples, or extras must use their specific contracts.
   - Evidence: converted MCP tools expose copied `mcp_annotations` metadata; it does not grant approval or become a model tool schema. Decisions examples use a separate OpenAI client with named typed answers and conservative refusal handling. Core Python support remains >=3.10 and the OpenAI dependency remains >=3.0.0,<4. The examples require OpenAI >=3.26.0,<4; the Temporal extra pins 1.34.0 and the Vercel extra accepts >=0.7.0,<0.9.
   - Files: `src/agents/mcp/util.py`, `src/agents/tool.py`, `examples/decisions/`, `pyproject.toml`, `uv.lock`.
   - Action: treat MCP annotations as untrusted discovery hints. Non-MCP and unannotated tools return `None`; reads return copies. Omitted hints stay omitted, so apply the installed MCP defaults yourself. The metadata is not serialized into tool origin. Install the example-specific SDK version and retain separate client/tracing ownership. Refresh application lockfiles when adopting the changed extras.

### Documentation coverage (non-blocking)

- Coverage source: current candidate documentation and a fresh search of all open PRs. The only open documentation PR is #5370 at `7754b11c7a8b4a2a0e9492f43de5f4762c456367`; its complete diff removes Runloop guidance for unmerged #5369. It does not cover this release's new obligations. Runloop removal is outside this candidate.
- Status: partially covered.
- Covered obligations: existing SDK/agent version routing for saved tasks; tracing opt-out and local sandbox limits; MCP callable approval policies; computer safety checks; Decisions example setup, separate client ownership, refusal handling, and routing limitations.
- Gaps and exact post-release suggestions:

| File and section | Wording or example to add |
| --- | --- |
| `docs/human_in_the_loop.md`, "Versioning pending tasks" and "Serialization options" | Explain schema 1.21, the legacy hook-identity restriction, and finishing affected tasks on their original SDK/agent code. Recommend unique names for new durable runs; same-name agents indistinguishable without hook attributes cannot serialize. Explain that unserializable dataclass context is omitted with a warning; show a serializer/deserializer or `context_override`, and `strict_context=True` to reject omission. |
| `docs/running_agents.md`, `tool_error_formatter`; `docs/tools.md`, "Handling errors in function tools" | Add `tool_exception`, `error`, callback migration, `None` fallback, explicit per-tool precedence, exclusions, and safe model-visible messages. |
| `docs/results.md`, failure recovery and pending input | Explain retained completed outputs, absent custom output metadata after failed extraction, original session ownership, and the terminal-output replay limit. State that completed stop tools can reject added pending input; finish that run before starting a new user turn. |
| `docs/sessions/index.md`, Conversations, Redis, and compaction sections | Document 20-item request batches and partial-append reconciliation. Multi-request writes disable client retries and drain the current request on cancellation; single-request writes retain client behavior. Explain deferred compaction during approvals; standalone Redis atomic replacement, Cluster write restrictions, and application coordination across writers. |
| `docs/mcp.md`, tool discovery and agent-level configuration | Document `FunctionTool.mcp_annotations` as copied optional metadata; absent annotations return `None` and omitted hints remain omitted. Consumers apply the installed MCP defaults. State that metadata neither authorizes execution nor enters model schemas or serialized tool origin. Distinguish MCP failure handlers from the run-wide formatter. |
| `docs/sandbox/clients.md`, local and hosted clients | Optionally note macOS Launch Services denial and document the Vercel >=0.7.0,<0.9 bound. Preserve the existing local-isolation limitations. |

- Publication timing: publish documentation for new behavior after 0.24.0 is available. These documentation gaps do not block the release.

### Key Changes draft

## Key Changes

0.24.0 adds run-wide function error formatting and MCP discovery annotations, and improves recovery, sandbox safety, and tracing. This minor release includes compatibility changes for custom error callbacks and some saved agent graphs. Review the first two highlights before upgrading.

### Highlights:

- **Update custom error formatters.** `RunConfig.tool_error_formatter` can receive `kind="tool_exception"` and an optional `error`. Handle the new kind or return `None` to retain the default message. Explicit per-tool handlers keep precedence; unconfigured defaults stay unchanged.
- **Plan upgrades around saved runs.** New RunState snapshots use schema 1.21. Finish affected older same-name agent graphs on their original SDK. Keep the agent code and original hook ordering unchanged. Use unique agent names for new durable runs; renaming a saved graph is not a migration.
- **Recover completed work more reliably.** Deferred approval history, completed tool outputs, aliases, and compaction state survive supported recovery paths. Automatic compaction waits for approvals. Redis replaces history atomically on supported standalone clients. Conversations appends respect the 20-item request limit. Reconcile partial writes before retrying.
- **Harden local execution and display.** macOS sandbox commands deny Launch Services requests. Sandbox tools recover from invalid model arguments. Protected mount errors preserve caller exception data while detaching the caught traceback. The realtime demo displays tool content as text.
- **Honor tracing choices through resume and cleanup.** Per-run tracing opt-out applies inside caller traces, and approved resumed tools attach to the resumed agent span.
- **Use richer integration examples and metadata.** MCP tools expose optional `mcp_annotations` as discovery hints. New Decisions recipes demonstrate classification, routing, and tool review with OpenAI >=3.26.0,<4. They use a separate client, not an Agents model adapter.
- **Refresh optional dependency locks.** The Temporal extra uses `temporalio==1.34.0`; the Vercel extra supports `vercel-sandbox>=0.7.0,<0.9`. Core Python and OpenAI SDK minimums are unchanged.

Thanks to @masasron for reporting the macOS local sandbox issue fixed in #5335.

### Notes

- This review covers the exact candidate above, including its release metadata. Changes to main, the candidate, or its API baseline require a fresh release check and approval.

## [1.22.0] - 2026-10-15

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Python 3.15 support:** The core framework and root `agent-framework` package now support Python 3.15, but not every package, optional extra, or feature supports it yet because of upstream dependency constraints. Before upgrading, check the README for each package and extra you use. The [Python README](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/blob/main/python/README.md#python-315-limitations) summarizes the currently known limitations.

> [!WARNING]
> **Persisted-state compatibility:** This applies to persisted artifacts that contain serialized Agent Framework `Content` or streamed response-update records. That includes chat and message histories; session stores and protocol snapshots when they embed those records; and workflow checkpoints only when their checkpoint state contains them. Plain session metadata and checkpoints without serialized messages, content, or response updates are unaffected.
>
> The 1.22 runtime can read records written by earlier releases, but pre-1.22 runtimes cannot read new records containing `hosted` or `merge_mode`. Do not run old and new workers against the same affected store during a rolling deployment, and do not downgrade after 1.22 has written these records unless the new state is isolated or migrated.

新增能力集中在图像处理与复合工具链：Google AUDIO 输出模态、openai-compatible 的 URL 图像、typesafe-ai 的图片输入与 insertReference、harness 系列的工具审批与模型输出转换
ai 核心新增可配置的工具调用执行并发；多个 provider 修复了工具输入增量、provider 引用文件与 thinking+工具选择的兼容问题
gateway/provider 多为 chore 模型设置文件的例行更新（含若干 backport）

releases.summary:
### Patch Changes

- 90983d7: feat(harness-pi): add configurable writable sandbox roots for Pi's native file tools
- d10fa3e: feat(harness-pi): pass the harness session to extension factories

  Each `extensionFactories` entry now receives a second argument, a `PiHarnessExtensionSession` with the restricted `sandboxSession`, the `sessionWorkDir` and an `instructions()` getter for the current turn's instructions. An extension can now run work against the session's sandbox with the session's instructions, such as a tool that delegates to a child Pi session. Existing `(pi) => void` factories keep working unchanged.

- 9323fdb: feat(harness-pi): serve mcpServers with Pi's native MCP and tool_search

  `mcpServers` is now served by Pi's built-in MCP extension and its `tool_search` tool instead of `pi-mcp-adapter`, which is no longer a dependency. Each entry is Pi's `McpServerConfig`: stdio `{ command, args, env, cwd }` or streamable HTTP `{ url, headers, timeout }`, plus `exposure`, `toolExposure`, `enabled` and `description`. The setting stays typed as `Record<string, unknown>` like the other harnesses; type entries with the exported `PiMcpServerConfig`. Fields that only the adapter understood, such as `lifecycle`, are no longer supported.

  Tool names are always `mcp__<server>__<tool>`, with `-` in either name replaced by `_`, so a server named `brand-ai` now yields `mcp__brand_ai__<tool>`. `exposure` defaults to `direct`, which declares a server's tools to the model. `deferred` tools stay undeclared until the model loads them through `tool_search` and then calls them by name. Pi's own default, `codemode`, is not supported because the harness does not load Pi's codemode extension; an entry that asks for it fails session start, as does an entry Pi rejects.

  `mcpSettings.toolPrefix` and `mcpSettings.outputGuard` are deprecated. A `toolPrefix` other than `'mcp'` or `outputGuard: false` now fails session start, since native MCP cannot honor either. Pi truncates text results over 20 KB and writes the full text to a file in the host temp directory.

  The harness has no sign-in flow, so an HTTP server that requires authentication must carry an `Authorization` header or `auth.provider`; with the header, OAuth never runs. The harness reads no `mcp.json` and neither reads nor writes `mcp.log` or `mcp-auth.json`, so a sign-in stored by the Pi CLI is never sent. `@earendil-works/pi-ai` is no longer a direct dependency.

- 286e0c7: fix(harness-pi): return images from the read tool as image blocks

  The `read` tool decoded every file as UTF-8, so the model received an image as unreadable text. The tool now runs Pi's own `createReadToolDefinition` over the sandbox: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP and BMP files come back as image blocks that Pi resizes, and text reads keep Pi's truncation and paging notices. The tool still takes `file_path`, and path mapping and `fileToolPathPolicy` apply as before.

- 8ae0804: fix(harness-pi): judge a turn by its last attempt and keep suspend errors out of the stream

  A turn that Pi recovered by retrying a failed request (rate limit, overload, context overflow after compaction) ended with an `error` part, because the first terminal error seen was kept for the whole turn. The last assistant message now decides the outcome, so a recovered turn ends with `finish`.

  Once `doSuspendTurn` has begun, every terminal or thrown error of the turn being cut belongs to the suspend and no longer emits an `error` part. Before, only errors that looked like an abort were kept silent, and a request Pi started on an already-aborted signal reports `stopReason: 'error'` ("This operation was aborted") while a provider can also fail during the cut. Reporting such an error ended the slice as failed with the unfinished turn nested in its resume state, and a session built from that state refused every later prompt.

- Updated dependencies [2e89fa4]
  - @ai-sdk/provider-utils@5.0.60
  - @ai-sdk/harness@1.0.152
